alignments.note: Rule 14: the ASV renders this waw by *Then*.
Rule 17: the subject pronoun joins the verb, headed on the lexical verb.
Interjection → *Ah*.
Vocative noun → *Lord*.
The ASV writes *Lord* without a possessive, so this suffix takes nothing.
Divine name → *Jehovah*.
Presentative particle → *behold*.
Noun → *soul*.
Rule 18: suffix → *my*.
Negative → *not*, written as a separate word.
Rule 17: the auxiliaries join the participle's passive rendering, headed on *polluted*; the unit is discontinuous around *not* under rule 25.
Rule 14: the ASV renders this clause-opening waw by *for*, which is on the rule's open list; a connective written for a waw is never `added`.

Rule 46: the anarthrous substantive is recast as *that which dieth of itself*, and the supplied antecedent, relative and completing words join its unit, headed on the word carrying the lexeme. The partitive *of* attaches this object to the verb and no other morpheme licenses it, so it joins the same unit; the competing reading would attach *of* to the verb `אָכַלְתִּי`.
Rule 14: the ASV renders this waw by *or*.
Rule 46 with rule 20's copula: the substantive is recast as *is torn of beasts*, headed on the word carrying the lexeme; *beasts* is supplied to complete the phrase under rule 31.
Negative → *not*, written as a separate word.
Rule 17: subject pronoun and auxiliary join the verb, headed on *eaten*; the unit is discontinuous around *not* under rule 25.
Rule 25: *from ... up* is one English prepositional expression realizing this `מִן`, discontinuous around the noun; the head is the word carrying the lexeme.
Noun → *youth*.
Rule 18: suffix → *my*.
Rule 14: the ASV renders this waw by *even*, exactly as in `וָיָמָּה` → *even unto the sea*.
Preposition → *till*.
Adverb → *now*.

Rule 35: the single word *neither* carries both the coordination and the negation, so the waw and the negative share one unit, headed on the negative — which is what distinguishes it from a bare *and*. No answering *nor* is written, so rule 14's correlative clause does not apply.
Rule 17: the presentative dummy *there* belongs to the verb's unit, and the unit still heads on the lexical verb.
Preposition → *into*.
Noun → *mouth*.
Rule 18: suffix → *my*.
Rule 28: the construct chain is rendered attributively (*abominable flesh*), so the construct noun takes *flesh*.
Rule 28: the rectum is rendered attributively as *abominable*.

review_notes: The clause-opening waw of `וּנְבֵלָה` carries the ASV's *for* under rule 14, so nothing here is `added`; the *even* before *till now* likewise answers to the waw of `וְעַד־עַתָּה`.
The partitive *of* before *that which dieth* is placed with the recast substantive rather than with the verb; the competing reading is named in that unit's note.
